groups.description: Model, effort, fast mode, thinking, output style, vim mode, session name

groups.label: Session totals
groups.description: Estimated cost, durations, lines added and removed

items.label: User
items.description: The login name

items.label: Hostname
items.description: The short host name

items.label: Session folder
items.description: The session's folder, home shown as ~, long paths cut to their end

items.label: Context used
items.description: Tokens in the context window (input, cache writes and cache reads)

items.label: Context size
items.description: The most tokens the context window holds

items.label: Context %
items.description: Percentage of the context window used

items.label: Model
items.description: The model's display name

items.label: Effort
items.description: Reasoning effort level, when the model has one

items.label: Fast mode
items.description: Shows 'fast' while fast mode is on

items.label: Thinking
items.description: Shows 'thinking' while extended thinking is on

items.label: Output style
items.description: The output style's name

items.label: Vim mode
items.description: NORMAL, INSERT and so on, when vim mode is on

items.label: Session name
items.description: The session's name or generated title

items.label: Cost
items.description: Estimated session cost in US dollars

items.label: Duration
items.description: Wall-clock time since the session started

items.label: API time
items.description: Time spent waiting on the API

items.label: Lines added
items.description: Lines of code added this session

items.label: Lines removed
items.description: Lines of code removed this session

items.label: Repository
items.description: owner/name of the origin remote

items.label: Branch
items.description: The current git branch, or the short commit when detached (runs git)

items.label: Worktree
items.description: The worktree's name, inside a worktree

items.label: Pull request
items.description: The open PR for this branch, with its review state

items.label: 5-hour limit
items.description: Percentage of the 5-hour rate limit used (Pro and Max)

items.label: 7-day limit
items.description: Percentage of the 7-day rate limit used (Pro and Max)

items.label: Spend limit
items.description: Percentage of a gateway spend limit used

items.label: Cache hit ratio
items.description: Share of input read from the prompt cache this session

items.label: Cache time left
items.description: Time until the prompt cache goes cold
